requirements.quote:
Optional components are denoted by enclosing them in "[[ ]]" (double
   brackets).
requirements.condition: a component is enclosed in double brackets in a presentation-language definition
requirements.forbidden_behavior: treat a double-bracketed component as unconditionally required
requirements.why_checkable: Parsers and serializers generated from a definition can be checked for permitted omission of the marked component.

requirements.quote:
Single-byte entities containing uninterpreted data are of
   type opaque.
requirements.required_behavior: represent it as one byte of uninterpreted data
requirements.forbidden_behavior: assign numeric interpretation or a multi-byte width to a scalar opaque entity
requirements.why_checkable: Opaque scalar serialization has a fixed one-byte width and no numeric decoding step.
